title: Annotated Transcript Explorer
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Explore a fictional high school transcript region by region and learn what each part tells an admissions reader.

learningObjectives: Students will identify the main regions of a high school transcript and explain what each one tells an admissions reader.

controls: Read it like an officer button

keyQuestions: Why do colleges recalculate GPA instead of using the number on the transcript?
What does a reader learn from the senior-year courses before any senior grades exist?
If your school doesn't rank, what does the college use instead?
commonMisconceptions: The GPA is the only part of the transcript that matters.
Students can send their own transcript; it must come from the school.
assessmentOpportunities: Students locate all nine regions on an unfamiliar transcript and explain what at least five of them tell a reader.
